pc.camera.hint: A photo opens in the editor before it is sent. A video is sent when you stop it (one minute at most). On a Mac, the first use asks for camera permission.
pc.camera.unavailable: The camera could not be opened.
pc.camera.video_failed: The video could not be recorded.
pc.groups.discover.empty: Groups announced by OSHI phones and computers on this network appear here, usually within a minute. A group you were invited to can be joined with its link or QR code.
pc.groups.discover.gone: That group is no longer being announced. Ask a member for its invite link.
pc.groups.discover.mesh_off: This computer is not listening to the local network. Public groups are announced by OSHI devices on the same network; start listening to hear them.
pc.groups.discover.privacy: Listening makes this computer visible to OSHI devices on the network, as on the phones. Joining asks the group's admin to add you; your messages stay end-to-end encrypted.
pc.groups.discover.step1: Be on the same Wi-Fi or local network as people running OSHI.
pc.groups.discover.subtitle: Public groups announced on your local network
pc.groups.discover.title: Discover groups
pc.groups.qr.save_failed: The image could not be saved there.
pc.groups.qr.saved: QR code saved. Anyone with OSHI can join by scanning it or choosing it as a picture.
pc.help.add.a: Open New chat. Paste the person's OSHI code or invite link, choose a picture of their QR code, or scan their code with this computer's camera. Your own QR code is on the same screen for them to scan.
pc.help.add.q: How do I add a contact on a computer?
pc.help.groups.a: Paste the group's invite link in New chat, or choose a picture of its QR code. Public groups announced by OSHI devices on your network appear in Discover groups.
pc.help.groups.q: How do I join a group?
pc.help.offline.a: On a local network, yes: OSHI computers and phones on the same Wi-Fi find each other and exchange messages directly. A computer has no Bluetooth mesh. With a LoRa radio connected, short texts can also travel by radio.
pc.help.offline.q: Does OSHI work without internet on a computer?
pc.help.passcode.a: On the lock screen choose "Forgot your passcode?" and paste your recovery key. OSHI opens and removes the passcode; you can set a new one in Settings › Security. Wrong passcodes never delete anything.
pc.help.passcode.q: I forgot my passcode. What now?
pc.help.same_account.a: Only if you choose it. On the first screen, import your phone's recovery key and this computer becomes the same identity. Create a new identity instead and the computer is a separate account with its own address.
pc.help.same_account.q: Is OSHI on my computer the same account as on my phone?
pc.help.subtitle: Questions and answers, and where to get help
pc.lock.auto.title: Lock after
pc.lock.footer: OSHI asks for the passcode when it opens and after the time below without use. The passcode itself is never stored: only a salted hash is kept on this computer. If you forget it, the recovery key unlocks OSHI and removes the passcode. Wrong attempts never erase anything.
pc.lock.limit: The passcode locks the window, not the files: your messages on this computer are encrypted by the key vault either way. A locked window shows no names or text in notifications.
pc.lock.not_set: Anyone using this computer can open OSHI.
pc.lock.recovery.hint: Paste this account's recovery key, the same key that restores it on a phone. OSHI unlocks and the passcode is removed; you can set a new one in Settings › Security.
pc.lock.recovery.wrong: That is not this account's recovery key.
pc.lock.screen.subtitle: Enter your passcode to open your messages.
pc.lock.set_done: Passcode set. OSHI will ask for it when it opens.
pc.lock.subtitle: Passcode for this window
pc.lock.too_short: At least 4 characters: digits, letters or both.
pc.markup.blur.hint: Drag a box over what must not be seen: faces, names, numbers. Blurred areas cannot be recovered from what is sent.
pc.markup.crop.hint: Drag the area to keep. Undo removes the crop.
pc.markup.draw.hint: Drag on the photo to draw.
pc.markup.failed: The edited photo could not be prepared.
pc.markup.text.hint: Click where the text goes, type it, then press Enter.
pc.markup.title: Edit photo
pc.privacy.calls.footer: A call from someone you have no conversation with on this computer does not ring, and the caller is not told.
pc.privacy.last_seen.detail: Off: the people you write to are not told when you were last active.
pc.privacy.photo.detail: Off: your profile photo is not sent to the people you write to.
